episodes.152784: Heavy rain brought flooding to parts of northeast Arkansas at the end of October.
episodes.153093: A low pressure system merged with Tropical Storm Zeta over the Gulf before pushing northeastward and pushing a cold front across the region and stalling along the southern portions of the area. Given the ground was already sufficiently saturated from ample accumulations several days prior, additional rainfall from storms along the cold front produced flooding across portions of Broward.
episodes.153253: A deepening low pressure system tracking across the provinces of central Canada produced storm force southerly winds across Lake Superior on the 31st.
episodes.153255: A deepening low pressure system tracking through the provinces of south central Canada generated south storm force wind gusts at Minneapolis Shoal Light on the Bay of Green Bay on the 31st.
episodes.153483: As a strong cold front from the west/northwest pushed through central and eastern Montana, scattered rain showers aided in bringing gusty winds in excess of 60 mph from aloft, down to the surface for many locations.
